title: Casa Verde Hotels: monthly review (October)
attendees: Daniel Reyes <daniel@brightline.example>, Priya Nair <priya@brightline.example>, Sofía Medina <sofia.medina@casaverde.example>
transcript:
Daniel: So October: direct bookings up 14% versus September, mostly from the Tulum property.
Sofía: That's great. Though I need to flag something. The report we got last week still showed Oaxaca as a separate brand. We merged it in September. My director noticed.
Daniel: Sorry about that. Priya, can you fix the October report so Oaxaca sits under Casa Verde, and resend it?
Priya: Yes, I'll have the revised version out tomorrow.
Sofía: Thanks. Second thing. We're opening in Valle de Bravo in March. Can you start thinking about a launch plan?
Daniel: Absolutely. I'll put together a first outline with channels and a rough budget. Would two weeks work?
Sofía: Two weeks is fine.
Daniel: Also, we're still waiting for approval on the December holiday creatives. We sent them on the 15th.
Sofía: I know. Legal has them. I'll push, but I can't promise before next week.
Daniel: Understood. And one more: you mentioned last month a new head of marketing might join.
Sofía: Yes, Carla Ruiz starts on the 10th. She'll want to review all agencies in her first month, so I'd like her to see results early.
Daniel: Then let's set up an intro with Carla in her first week. I'll prepare a one-page results summary for her.
Sofía: Good idea.
Priya: Quick one, Sofía. Can we get access to the new booking engine analytics? Right now we're estimating conversions.
Sofía: I'll ask IT to give you viewer access.
